verdict.rationale: Dots is an always-on agent that reads data from connected apps such as Gmail, Google Drive, GitHub and local files. It proactively reaches out with results and decisions, and can flag problems it finds in your data, for example a release decision that conflicts with a draft you shared earlier. It also keeps notes on your preferences and ongoing work to use in later conversations. Missing for 10: insight and suggestion generation is shown only through brief example phrases rather than documented in depth, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
